C0911.title: “4.09” Cross-Border Gambling Case: Money Laundering via Paofen Platforms Exceeds 300 Billion Yuan
C0911.summary: In June 2020, police dismantled the “4.09” cross-border gambling operation, breaking up a major criminal syndicate that used paofen (running score) platforms to transfer funds for offshore gambling. Disguised as online part-time jobs, the platform fragmented and dispersed large gambling sums through ordinary accounts, with total transaction flows surpassing 300 billion yuan. Authorities arrested 9

references.title: Details emerge in a massive case exceeding 30 billion yuan; central bank issues important warning
